    Legend of a mask

    Source: R/mask.R
    at_mask_legend.Rd

    Legend of a mask

    Usage

    at_mask_legend(mask, call = rlang::caller_env())

    Arguments

    mask

    An annot_mask.

    call

    The calling environment, for error reporting.

    Value

    The mask's legend tibble::tibble (value, label, layer, roi_id, n_px, colour).

    See also

    Other masks: at_mask(), at_mask_agreement(), at_mask_boundary(), at_mask_derive(), at_mask_preview(), at_mask_stack(), at_mask_stats(), at_read_mask(), at_read_npy(), at_write_mask(), at_write_masks(), at_write_npy()

    Examples

    at_mask_legend(at_mask(at_example_project(), "labelled"))
#> # A tibble: 3 × 6
#>   value label    layer   roi_id         n_px colour 
#>   <int> <chr>    <chr>   <chr>         <int> <chr>  
#> 1     1 tumour   regions roi_000000040 19600 #999999
#> 2     2 necrosis regions roi_000000041 72704 #E69F00
#> 3     3 stroma   regions roi_000000042 34200 #56B4E9
